description: Go client for the Ozon Performance API with automatic OAuth2 token management. Covers 44 API methods across 6 service modules: campaigns, statistics, ads, product bids, search-promo, vendor reports.
rules: Use context.Context for all API calls
The client fetches the OAuth2 bearer token automatically; call client.Token(ctx) only for manual inspection
Handle *transport.APIError for non-2xx responses via errors.As
IDs and monetary values use transport.Uint64, tolerant of JSON number and string forms
Report endpoints returning CSV/ZIP return raw []byte: MediaCampaignList, ProductCampaignList, GetCampaignExpense, GetCampaignDailyStats, DownloadStatistics
